name: WASM-4 City
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A port of MicroCity for Arduboy: build and manage your own city in a SimCity-style simulation. Arrows to move around, buttons to act. No sound.

descriptions.en: A port of MicroCity for Arduboy: build and manage your own city in a SimCity-style simulation. Arrows to move around, buttons to act. No sound.
descriptions.it: Porting di MicroCity per Arduboy: costruisci e gestisci la tua città in un gestionale in stile SimCity. Frecce per muoverti, pulsanti per le azioni. Senza audio.
